title: tier-2 shipped code: the character controller move, no-shape path, against MoveCharacterController

unreachableBranches.why: the fixture pins the shape index to -1, so the no-shape return is the only edge; the shape loop is open collision ingest

notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/world.rs (move_character_controller), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the mover_move_character entry.
The oracle runs MoveCharacterController (0x142cd4bc0) with entry in RCX, record in RDX and the move block in R8. The entry's shape index at +0x24 is -1, so the shape-query loop is skipped.

Cases cover a changed velocity, an unchanged xyz velocity (the early return), unchanged xyz with a different w, an unchanged velocity with old quat equal/unequal/normalised to the entry quat, non-normalised and zero quaternions, inf/NaN quats and random quats.
The no-shape path writes the normalised quaternion to entry+0x00, the new velocity to +0x10 and the record's +0x190 flag; both pointees are compared byte for byte.
acknowledgedGaps: Only the no-shape path is implemented: entry+0x24 != -1 returns false before any write. The shape query 0x142cb9030 and its event call 0x142cf32d0 are collision ingest and remain open. The coverage window ends at the shape-index test; the shape loop is outside it.
